answer: Let a newcomer enter only through vouchers from established identities, each voucher staking reputation that is slashed if the newcomer turns out fake. To forge one clone is easy; to forge a meadow of them means bribing or fooling hundreds of real sponsors, and every exposed fake burns its sponsors' standing too, so the network of trust shrinks around the fraud. A lotus of honest agents grows slowly, but each new member arrives already tied to someone accountable. Limit: early networks have few sponsors, so vouching power must be capped per sponsor.
